encoder_method_note:
The message is hidden in the heights of the 18 skyline buildings, read left to right: each building's height attribute equals the letter's alphabetical position (A=1, B=2, …) multiplied by 10, so 40→d, 180→r, 150→o, 160→p, and so on. Word boundaries are marked structurally by splitting the buildings into five `<g>` groups separated by wider street gaps, giving word lengths 4, 3, 5, 2, 4. All other elements (sky gradient, moon, stars, road, window pattern) are purely decorative and carry no information.
